task.title: To insert a clause from Playbook into a template

step.cmd: In the X-Author Templates pane, go to Work > Playbook > Search Clauses.
In the Search Clauses field, click the search icon to list all the available clauses or enter a search string to search a specific clause.
You can also click clause filter icon to get filtering options. You can filter the clause based on clause Category, Subcategory, Locale, Language, and Type.
In your template document, place the cursor at the point of insertion.

Click a clause from the list to view the clause text and guidance. Select the clause from the Playbook pane, click more icon next to the clause name and click Insert to insert the clause into your template as inline text.

postreq.p: You see a success message on successfully inserting a clause. The clause content is marked by a content control boundary in your template.
